# Generate AI Development Prompt

Learn the local project /Users/yuxuanli/Desktop/Project/Knowledge-Tree, and the "/ai" page. Generate a prompt file to develop a new embedAI feature under .github/prompts/embed_ai_prompt.md.

The new feature is to add a ai helper interface to the existed "/memos" page right corner, which click in, user can start a chat with the AI. Consider user experience and integration with existing components, draft a detailed prompt that outlines the step by step plan to develop this feature.

Requirement:

- The feature entrance lies at the right corner of the "/memos" page. Take the attached image as an example.
- By clicking the entrance button, a chat interface will pop up, allowing users to interact with the AI, ask questions, and receive responses in real-time. Refer to ChatGPT UI.
- This ai chat should leverage the same design as the existing ChatGPT-like AI chat interface under the "/ai" page. Share the same api call logic, chat history storage mechanism and UI style. User should be able to access the historical chat records with the embed ai helper under the "/ai" page.
